activity.title: Automated Commit Log Summary
activity.author: Brian Cullinan
activity.content_html: That's a valid point. If there's a question that doesn't make sense or doesn't have factual coherence, it's best not to answer it in any way. Instead, you can explain why the question is nonsensical or incoherent, or provide information on what would make the question coherent. This helps preserve the integrity of the conversation while also avoiding misleading information or answers.

jupyter_ops.title: Still trying to get Gemini dump to work
jupyter_ops.author: Brian Cullinan
jupyter_ops.summary: This commit introduces utility functions for handling date extraction and converting it to a clean, sortable format. The goal is to simplify the process of working with Gemini dump data.
jupyter_ops.content_html:
Update to jupyter_ops

As Brian Cullinan, I'm still working on getting the Gemini dump to work. I've added some utility functions to handle the date extraction and convert it to a clean, sortable format.

This makes it much easier to compare timelines between different dates.

By the way, I'm also working on improving the Gemini dump extraction algorithm to handle the latest Gemini dumps.
jupyter_ops.tldr: Still working on Gemini dump extraction and improving the algorithm.
